country.match: Match each house to its country.
country.odd: Three of these houses are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: White House
rows.description: official residence and office of the President of the United States
rows.hook: serves as the home and workplace of the U.S. president in Washington, D.C

rows.label: Neuschwanstein Castle
rows.description: castle in Bavaria, Germany, Europe
rows.hook: is a fairytale hilltop fortress in the Alps that inspired the Disney logo

rows.label: Palace of Versailles
rows.description: palace in Versailles, France and location of the Museum of the History of France
rows.hook: was the lavish home of the Sun King and is famed for its Hall of Mirrors

rows.label: Forbidden City
rows.description: Chinese imperial palace in Beijing
rows.hook: was the vast walled home of emperors in Beijing, beside Tiananmen Square

rows.label: Alhambra
rows.description: palace and fortress complex in Granada, Andalusia, Spain
rows.hook: is a hilltop Moorish fortress-palace with ornate courtyards and the Court of the Lions

rows.label: Windsor Castle
rows.description: historic castle, royal residence at Windsor in Berkshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is the oldest continuously occupied fortress home of the monarch, west of London

rows.label: The Crystal Palace
rows.description: former building originally in Hyde Park, London, 1854 relocated to Bromley, South London
rows.hook: was a giant glass-and-iron hall built for the Great Exhibition and later lost to fire

rows.label: Graceland
rows.description: mansion in Memphis, Tennessee, United States; former residence of Elvis Presley
rows.hook: was the Memphis mansion home of the King of Rock and Roll, now a museum

rows.label: Clarence House
rows.description: official residence of king Charles III, and his wife Camilla
rows.hook: is the London residence linked to the Queen Mother and later to the current king

rows.label: Kensington Palace
rows.description: royal residence set in Kensington Gardens, London, England, UK
rows.hook: is the London home where Princess Diana lived and where William and Kate have lived

rows.label: Topkapı Palace
rows.description: palace museum in Istanbul, Turkey
rows.hook: was the Ottoman sultans' Bosphorus-side home, now a museum holding the Spoonmaker's Diamond

rows.label: Palace of the Parliament
rows.description: multi-purpose building in Romania
rows.hook: is often called the heaviest and one of the largest administrative buildings in the world

rows.label: Winter Palace
rows.description: former imperial palace in Saint Petersburg, Russia
rows.hook: was the home of the tsars and houses the Hermitage Museum

rows.label: Hampton Court Palace
rows.description: historic royal palace in Richmond, Greater London
rows.hook: was a favorite of Henry VIII and is known for its famous hedge maze

rows.label: Apostolic Palace
rows.description: official residence of the Pope in Vatican City
rows.hook: is the papal residence next to St. Peter's Basilica and the Sistine Chapel

rows.label: Hawa Mahal
rows.description: palace in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
rows.hook: is the pink sandstone Palace of Winds with hundreds of small latticed windows

rows.label: Gyeongbokgung
rows.description: palace in Seoul, South Korea
rows.hook: is the largest of the Joseon dynasty's royal residences, with a guarded gate ceremony

rows.label: Holyrood Palace
rows.description: official residence of the British monarch in Scotland
rows.hook: is the King's official residence in Edinburgh, once home to Mary, Queen of Scots

rows.label: Royal Palace of Madrid
rows.description: official residence of the Spanish Royal Family
rows.hook: is the largest of its kind in Europe by floor area, yet is used only for state ceremonies

rows.label: Hofburg Palace
rows.description: palace located in Vienna, Austria
rows.hook: was the winter home of the Habsburg emperors and is now home to the Spanish Riding School

rows.label: Dolmabahçe Palace
rows.description: palace in Istanbul, Turkey
rows.hook: is an opulent Ottoman residence on the Bosphorus where Atatürk died

rows.label: Royal Pavilion
rows.description: former royal residence located in Brighton, England, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is a seaside retreat with onion domes and minarets in an Indian-inspired style
